verdict.rationale: Llama's open-weight distribution model lets users self-host on their own infrastructure or choose among multiple cloud partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM, Oracle, etc.), which indirectly gives control over where data/inference resides, but there is no explicit product feature, policy, or documentation addressing data residency/region selection as a privacy control. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-selection settings, documented compliance guarantees (e.g., GDPR region locking), and any first-party statement framing self-hosting as a privacy/residency feature.
